rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: on <=768px viewports the .ew-action-inner used default row layout, causing the wide DOWNLOAD BROCHURE button (padding 18px 38px, nowrap) to push past 390px viewport. Fix applied: media query max-width:768px sets .ew-action-inner{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}, .ew-action-cta{flex-direction:column-reverse;width:100%}, .ew-btn{width:100%;padding 18px 20px}. Verified: no button's right edge exceeds 370px on 390px viewport (20px side padding = symmetric). Order verified visually: GALLERY (top, centered) -> DOWNLOAD BROCHURE (gold, middle) -> BOOK UNIT (outline, bottom) due to column-reverse on .ew-action-cta which has DOM order [BOOK UNIT, DOWNLOAD BROCHURE].
